completeness.why: All five provider functions now only compute their own bank lookup key and account fields and delegate the whole upgrade/insert, transfer payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and sync-event sequence to linkBankSyncAccount.

interface.why: syncSource, bankId, newAccountFields and syncEventTables carry the real variation (mask/official name and Akahu's tables are explicit), but the Pluggy.ai-only file id is not a parameter: the helper reads cloudFileId for every provider, silently erasing a listed preserved inconsistency instead of making it explicit.
